scotland-loch-ness-and-glen-affric.title: Scotland · Loch Ness and Glen Affric
scotland-loch-ness-and-glen-affric.slogan: A 132 km loop out of Drumnadrochit
scotland-loch-ness-and-glen-affric.story: Water, forest and Highland atmosphere without chasing a postcard queue. Out of Drumnadrochit and back again: 132 km, roughly 2 h 17 in the saddle. The stops in between: Loch Ness view, Glen Affric forest core and Beauly. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.

sections.advice: This Loch Ness view → Glen Affric forest core stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Glen Affric forest core → Beauly food stop is the reward section in Scotland. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.title: A82 Glencoe and Great Glen
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 6 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: A82 Glencoe and Great Glen
scenicChapters.narrative: For 23 km this is A82 Glencoe and Great Glen, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
